pairwiseMAINComparisons.rightMain: Return closes an active loan; it does not create a future claim to a currently unavailable copy.

pairwiseMAINComparisons.leftMain: Reserve requests access to an unavailable copy; renewal extends the due date of the same active loan.
pairwiseMAINComparisons.rightMain: Renewal continues an existing loan and is distinct from placing a hold for another copy.
